Compare Soundscaper Desktop with SoundCraft 0.19.0. For all editors, reviewed sources, and rating conventions, see [How Soundscaper compares](/start/how-soundscaper-compares/).

`+` means supported, `~` means limited, `/` means unavailable, and `?` means not verified. Hover, focus, or tap an underlined cell for its qualification. Ratings cover built-in features and the hosting capabilities explicitly listed.

[Choose another comparison](/start/comparisons/)

## Project format support

`+` means read and write; `~` marks one-way or incomplete support. Hover for
conversion limits. External converters do not count. Media must accompany
formats that reference separate files.

| Format | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | SoundCraft<br>0.19.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Soundscaper (`.sscape`) | + — :: Original media is referenced by default; consolidation bundles it for portability. | / |
| REAPER (`.rpp`) | / | / |
| Audacity (`.aup`) | ~ — Import :: Imports the legacy project and its companion media; no AUP export. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup3`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup4`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | / |
| Cool Edit / Audition (`.ses`) | ~ — Import :: Recognized legacy binary layouts only; unsupported state and missing media are reported. No export. | / |
| Audition (`.sesx`) | ~ — Import :: Imports audio tracks, clip placement, trims, simple fades, and static mixer settings. Effects, automation, routing, and other unsupported state are reported; no SESX export. | / |
| Ardour (`.ardour`) | ~ — Import :: Audio playlists, cuts, trims, static mix settings, and explicit fades; locates nearby media or requests a folder. MIDI, plug-ins, automation, routing, and tempo maps are omitted; no export. | / |
| Hindenburg (`.nhsx`) | / | / |
| Pro Tools (`.ptf`) | ~ — Import :: Supported native PTF audio edits, track names, trims, and stereo lanes; locates the Audio Files folder. Legacy PTS is also supported. Mix settings, fades, MIDI, and plug-ins are omitted; no export. | / |
| Pro Tools (`.ptx`) | ~ — Import :: Supported native PTX audio-edit layouts; locates the Audio Files folder. Missing media and unsupported mix settings, fades, MIDI, and plug-ins are reported; no export. | / |
| SoundCraft (`.scraft`, `.scraftz`) | ~ — Import :: Audio cuts, trims, static mix settings, and explicit fades from sessions or bundled media. MIDI, plug-ins, automation, and routing are omitted; no export. | + — :: JSON session with separate media, or a portable SCRAFTZ bundle. |
| FL Studio (`.flp`, ZIP) | / | / |
| Ableton Live (`.als`) | / | / |
| Bitwig (`.bwproject`) | / | / |

## Interchange with other tools

Both Soundscaper editions import and export EDL, OpenTimelineIO, FCPXML, OMF,
AAF, and DAWproject.

| Capability | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | SoundCraft<br>0.19.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EDL | + — :: Import and export CMX3600 cuts; export uses one selected sequence track. | ~ — Session text |
| OpenTimelineIO | + — :: Import and export audio/video tracks, gaps, and supported nested stacks. | / |
| FCPXML | + — :: Import and export timeline spines, asset clips, and connected lanes. | / |
| DAWproject | + — :: Imports and exports media and supported project structure, with an exchange report. | / |
| OMF | + — :: Import and export OMF2 audio. Export embeds mono/stereo 24-bit WAV, with a 256 MiB decoded-PCM limit. | / |
| AAF | + — :: Import and export audio cuts and embedded media; unsupported processing and picture are reported. | / |
| Round-trip with a video editor | ~ — Framescaper copy :: File-menu handoff creates a separate editable Framescaper copy, with a conversion report | / |
| Blender track export and live sync | + — :: WAV track bundle and one-way edit updates through the bundled Blender 4.2+ add-on | / |
| Labels and markers exchange | + | ~ — Text / MIDI |
| AES31 ADL | + — Import / export :: AES31-3 audio cuts, source trims, linear fades, and static clip gain with BWF media; unsupported processing, automation, and authoring are reported. | / |

Transfers can omit unsupported state; review the exchange report. See [project formats](/projects-and-data/project-files/), [Blender sync](https://github.com/LeoWattenberg/Soundscaper/blob/main/docs/development/desktop-blender.md), and [Framescaper handoff](https://github.com/LeoWattenberg/Soundscaper/blob/main/docs/decisions/product-origins.md).

## Verdict totals {#verdict-totals}

Each comparison row counts once, including individual export formats. Products
are sorted by `+` count, then `~` count to break ties. These totals measure
coverage of the listed features: row selection and granularity affect the order.
They do not measure implementation depth, audio quality, performance, or reliability.
